rules.name: Explicit Persona Definition
rules.description: Defines an authoritative, domain-specialized professional role and persona.

rules.name: Clear Primary Objective
rules.description: States an unambiguous, action-oriented primary deliverable or goal.

rules.name: Comprehensive Depth
rules.description: Sufficient depth and technical rigor; avoids unhelpful brevity.

rules.name: Structural Markdown Sectioning
rules.description: Uses clean headers, logical sectioning, and structured markdown syntax.

rules.name: Granular Parameterization
rules.description: Provides granular, numbered or bulleted items rather than vague prose.

rules.name: Step-by-Step Execution Sequence
rules.description: Provides chronological or phased execution steps.

rules.name: Deterministic Keywords
rules.description: Uses exact technical standards, criteria, and determinative terms.

rules.name: Dedicated Context & Background
rules.description: Contains an explicit contextual block explaining the environment and stakeholders.

rules.name: Specialized Domain Scope
rules.description: Incorporates specialized domain nuances, standards, and vocabulary.

rules.name: Dedicated Constraints Section
rules.description: Explicitly details operational boundaries and requirements.

rules.name: Negative Guardrails
rules.description: Specifies negative conditions (what the model must NOT do or avoid).

rules.name: Explicit Output Format Section
rules.description: Explicitly mandates the response layout, structure, and sections.

rules.name: Concrete Syntax Specifications
rules.description: Defines exact formatting syntax such as Markdown, JSON, Tables, or Code.

rules.name: Documented Proactive Assumptions
rules.description: Articulates sensible default assumptions when human input is underspecified.

rules.name: Quality Verification Checklist
rules.description: Includes an actionable self-verification checklist for the executing model.
